rationale: The core fade thesis is intact — price remains below session VWAP (33.75), below the open, and well under the 33.80 invalidation, while the current 1m bounce is occurring on fading volume (9.0k→5.5k) into overhead supply, the classic corrective pattern for a failed-gap fade. The 9-EMA reclaim (33.59 vs 33.54) and higher 1m lows are a warning, but flipping long below VWAP in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.35%, VIXY +1.21%) has weaker evidence than the short, and the defined risk to invalidation (~$50) versus reward to the 33.15 target (~$105) still favors patience. Exit on a VWAP reclaim toward 33.75–33.80 rather than pre-emptively in midday chop.
